 ● Which kind of planting should the new raised bed in the back corner of the
   garden hold this season, given that the soil was only turned over last
   month?
   → Vegetables
 ● How much direct sunlight does the chosen spot get on an ordinary day in
   early summer, counting from the time the fence stops shading it in the
   morning?
   → Full sun
 ● Which layout should the bed use, bearing in mind the path along the south
   edge has to stay clear for the wheelbarrow and the hose reel?
   → Rows
 ● How much time each week can realistically go into weeding, watering and
   harvesting once the bed is planted and the first seedlings are up?
   → An hour
